# Method

The hypotheses, operationalizations, analysis plan, inference criteria, and sample size justification have been preregistered at <https://osf.io/537aq>. Open material and data are available at [https://osf.io/cy287](https://osf.io/cy287).

## Participants

The initial sample had `r nrow(dat)` participants. We preregistered to exclude participants who did not write anything in the writing assignment (`r sum(!dat$has_writing_assignment)` exclusions) or indicated that their data should not be used (`r sum(!dat$has_agreed)` exclusions), leading to a final sample size of *n* = `r nrow(dat_final)`. The final sample had a mean age of `r mean(demo$age, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(1)` (*SD* = `r sd(demo$age, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(1)`, range: `r min(demo$age, na.rm = TRUE)`--`r max(demo$age, na.rm = TRUE)`).
